list: The official 55 trophies as listed by PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 November 2026: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden until earned; all single-player, no online trophies.
note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in my own words for this guide; each one names the source its facts come from. Counts (250 stunts, 42 Shooting Range challenges, 14 drone-race locations, 18 meditation spots, 100 WAiNK locations, 52 areas, 9 gangs, 8 garages) come from the official list as mirrored by the trackers and the guides cited.

roadmap.title: Story first — Chapters 1 to 4
roadmap.text: Play the story straight through, Chapters 1-4, and take every meditation spot you pass: Lucia's balcony spot in Chapter 1 is the one missable trophy in the game, and there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. Story trophies land automatically as chapters and named missions end.

roadmap.title: Strangers and side characters
roadmap.text: After the story opens up, finish the mission strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, hunt Bret's unique animal, and complete 8 stranger strands across Leonida.

roadmap.title: Collectibles
roadmap.text: Sweep the map for the 3 collectible card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 vehicles and all 52 areas of Leonida. Do these while travelling for other tasks so the map fills in naturally.

roadmap.title: Activities and grinds
roadmap.text: Work the repeatable activities: 250 stunts, all 9 activity types, gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, drone races at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins, fishing against Cal, an arcade game, bowling, and 50 challenges.

roadmap.title: Free-roam, robberies and money
roadmap.text: With your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level and rob 3 shops back-to-back; rob 5 bank vaults, an armored truck, one illegal operation per gang and a jewelry store undetected; launder $250,000 in marked bills, spend $100,000 in shops, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles with Scooter Bros.

roadmap.title: Platinum
roadmap.text: Finish the final mission, reach 100% completion for A Long Road, and Vice Got a Price! pops with the last trophy. Expect a long road — guides estimate around 100-200 hours for the platinum.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order (story, side strands, collectibles, activities, money) and this is the last trophy you will hear. The 100% completion gold, A Long Road, is the usual final gate before it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first story mission of the game, so this trophy comes naturally within your first session. There is no mission replay, so if anything goes wrong mid-mission, restart from your manual save rather than hoping to replay it later. It unlocks when the mission's closing scene ends.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end; the trophy pops with the chapter's closing mission. While you are still in Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot — it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is the one spot that disappears after this chapter. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, since there is no mission replay.

The trophy is gold and pops when the credits roll, and it is one of the two golds on the road to the platinum.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion tracker. That tracker covers the story, side strands, activities and collectibles — but not literally everything in the game, so follow the in-game checklist rather than chasing every last item. Guides rank this the hardest trophy and the usual last one before the platinum; expect roughly 100-200 hours for the full platinum run. Check your completion percentage in the pause menu as you go.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts across Leonida — stunt jumps, airtime, near-misses and other driving feats all count toward the total. The counter runs in the background during normal play, so just drive fast and take jumps whenever you see a ramp or a drop; dedicated stunt-jump spots around Vice City are the fastest way to grind the remainder. It is a silver and one of the longer grinds, so start early and let it accumulate.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types in the game once — fishing, bowling, the shooting range, races, drone races, arcade games, meditation, hunting and the other open-world pastimes. You do not need to win or finish them well; one attempt at each is enough. Open the activities list in the pause menu and tick them off one by one, ideally as you meet them during the story.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting ranges around Leonida and work through each weapon challenge, aiming for the gold score threshold shown on screen. Use the weapon the challenge gives you, take your time on the timed lanes, and replay any challenge you miss gold on — they can be retried as often as you like. Guides rank this among the hardest trophies, so leave it for when your aim is warmed up.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 race locations across Leonida. Find the Top Fun vans or race markers on the map, enter a race, and beat the course time or the rival drones. Learn each course's turns on a practice run first, then go for the win — a win at a location is permanent, so you can clear the 14 one at a time between other tasks.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race event only counts once, so you need variety, not 20 wins on the same track. Work through the race markers around the map in different vehicle classes, and use a fast, well-handling car for each class. The tracker in the pause menu shows which races you have already won, so check it before repeating one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the fishing spots around Leonida's coast and waterways, take the fishing challenge against Cal, and land the bigger catch — watch the line tension and reel steadily rather than yanking. If you lose, you can challenge him again, so keep trying until your catch beats his.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet — in bars, arcades and other interiors around Vice City — start a game and play it through to its end. Any cabinet counts and you only need one completion, so pick the shortest game on offer and finish it.

Roam the state, answer every stranger marker you see, and keep a note of which strands you have finished; eight completed strands earn this silver.

trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Find Bret's marker to start his hunting strand, follow his directions to the animal's territory, and track it — move slowly, watch the wind and the animal's trail, and take a clean shot when you have it. The trophy pops when the hunt is delivered to Bret, not just when the animal falls.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, interiors, vehicles and out-of-the-way spots — and each set only counts when every card in it is found. Sweep each area thoroughly as you travel for other trophies, and use the in-game collection menu to see which cards of a set you still need before backtracking.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK spots are marked around the map — towns, landmarks, viewpoints and roadside stops — and each location counts once. Work through them region by region while you explore for The Goodtime State, so the two trophies progress together; the in-game counter shows how many locations you still need.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list — short goals such as stunt counts, driving feats, combat feats and activity milestones. Open the challenges menu in the pause screen, pick the easiest ones first (driving, stunts and exploration challenges fall naturally during play), and work down the list. Challenges overlap heavily with the other trophies, so many of the 50 will already be done by the time you focus on this one.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely. Start a rampage or a robbery together until four stars show, then break line of sight, get off the road and hide until the stars clear — a fast car and the back roads outside Vice City help. If you get caught, just try again; the trophy only needs one clean escape with your partner present.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the trick is to keep the wanted level, not lose it. Rob the first shop, drive straight to the next with your partner, and rob it before the cops catch you; repeat for the third. Pick three shops close together in Vice City, use a fast getaway car, and do not stop to fight the police between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts when you get in it for the first time, so drive anything new you see — cars, bikes, trucks, boats and aircraft all count toward the total. Cruise different districts, check parking lots and docks, and hop into every unfamiliar vehicle instead of sticking to your favourite car; the vehicle menu shows how many you have found.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group of enemies — a gang shootout or a police chase works — trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before the focus meter runs out. Use a fast-firing weapon, aim for the closest targets first, and do not waste focus time reloading mid-chain.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — steal a plane from the airport and take off without going through any scheduled flight. Get onto the tarmac, find a parked aircraft, climb in and get airborne while the airport security reacts. A small fast plane is easiest; once you are in the air and clear of the runways, the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: This trophy is about the Rhino tank: get into a Rhino and survive its firepower — the description's joke is that it is hot inside. Earn a high wanted level or provoke the military response until a Rhino rolls in, then deal with it (or steal it) rather than running. The trophy pops once you have faced a Rhino down in free roam.

trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go in quiet: move slowly, avoid the staff's line of sight and the cameras, take the goods and leave before any alarm sounds. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection fails the attempt, not the trophy. Night-time and a stealthy approach give you the best odds.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank robberies unlock in Chapters 3 and 4 — plan each one, bring your partner if the job calls for it, crack the vault, grab the cash and get clear of the police before the trophy counts it. You need five separate successful vault jobs, so space them out and use a fast car parked nearby for every getaway.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — find one on the road, stop it (ram it, block it or shoot out its tyres), crack it open, take the cash and lose the police. One clean job is all it takes; a quiet stretch of road outside the city makes the escape much easier.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Every named area on the map counts once you have visited it, so drive, fly and sail the whole state — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the inland towns. Check the map for greyed-out areas you have not visited yet, and clear them while doing WAiNK spots and card hunting so one trip covers three trophies.

Gang operations are marked around the map once robbery systems open in Chapters 3 and 4 — hit one operation per gang, and check the in-game list to see which gangs you still owe. Each gang's territory is different, so scout the operation first and bring the right weapon for its guards.

No confirmed exact trigger has been published at launch; if it has not popped by the end of your playthrough, retry any activity you failed once and pass it second time around.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garage sale signs appear on the map as you explore — visit each one, pay the asking price, and the property is yours. They are also useful: each garage stores your vehicles, so buy them as you find them and the trophy pops with the eighth purchase. Save up during the story's robbery jobs if the prices sting.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it — repeat for ten different vehicles. Any vehicles count, so use the cars already sitting in your garages first, then register new finds as you discover them for Whip It Good.
